nodes.title: Key Risks and Mitigation Strategies

nodes.title: Tax Strategy, Governance and Risk Control Framework
nodes.summary: Max Healthcare’s Tax Strategy, Governance and Risk Control Framework ensures integrity, transparency, and regulatory compliance across jurisdictions, aligned with governance principles and the Taxpayer’s Charter. Max Healthcare is transitioning to cleaner fuel options across its operations to effectively manage emissions. At few hospitals in Delhi and Super Speciality Hospital in Nagpur, certain fossil fuel-based vehicles have been replaced with electric vehicles (EVs). Additionally, over 100 EV charging points have been installed at the newly constructed Max Super Speciality Hospital Dwarka.
To further reduce indirect emissions, refrigerants with low global warming potential are being adopted and CO2 based fire extinguishers are being replaced with clean agent- based alternatives.
